item: Fable F-N02 -- temperature-based accessory shedding from BMI270 / ESP32-S3 die temperature
question: should firmware shed accessory power on an on-die temperature reading, as a product-level thermal control?
verdict: EVALUATED AND DECLINED FOR THE FIRST FIVE; REV-B CANDIDATE ONCE C-THERM-01 HAS MEASURED THE RELATIONSHIP

what_the_board_actually_has.bmi270_u4: an IMU die temperature register, on the internal I2C bus
what_the_board_actually_has.esp32s3_u1: an on-die temperature sensor inside the module's own shield can
what_the_board_actually_has.pack_ntc: NONE -- R38 is unfitted and the fitted 785060 pack has no thermistor

why_declined: A DIE TEMPERATURE IS NOT THE THING THE LIMITS ARE ABOUT.  The two limits this product has to respect are the BQ25185 JUNCTION (TI 125 C operating maximum) and the POUCH (0..60 C discharge, 0..40 C charge).  Neither is measured by either sensor: the BMI270 sits on the opposite side of the board from U11 and the ESP32-S3 die sits inside its own module shield, self-heated by its own radio.  The transfer function from either die to the charger junction or to the cell is unknown.

D790-A02 WARNS AGAINST EXACTLY THIS MOVE.  Round-10's own words: do not silently convert a thermal-model defect into a firmware temperature rule without proving the sensor relationship and the failure policy.  The relationship is what C-THERM-01 exists to measure and it has not been measured yet.

A CONTROL BUILT ON AN UNCHARACTERISED SENSOR HAS TWO FAILURE MODES AND BOTH ARE WORSE THAN NO CONTROL.  Too sensitive, and the product sheds a published capability on a radio's own self-heating.  Too insensitive, and it provides false assurance that the thermal envelope is being policed when it is not.

AND THE DEFECT IT WAS PROPOSED TO COVER IS FIXED ANOTHER WAY.  D-791's supported concurrency is a table of OBSERVABLE MODES -- which radio is transmitting, whether the amplifier is driving -- and the charge regime has a DERIVED ambient ceiling.  Both are things a human can act on without a sensor, which is what D790-A02 asks a declared restriction to be.
what_would_make_it_defensible: C-THERM-01 measures, at the declared sustained reference state and at the peak electrical envelope: external ambient, internal air, the BQ25185 land/package, the pouch surface, the BMI270 die register and the ESP32-S3 die register, simultaneously.
That yields a measured transfer function from each die reading to the two limits that matter, with a stated spread across the five first-article units.

Only then can a threshold be derived rather than chosen, and only then does a shedding rule have a failure policy that can be written down -- including what the firmware does when the sensor itself is unreadable, which must be fail-closed like every other measurement this board acts on.
retained_controls_that_do_not_need_a_sen: the F12 supported-concurrency table, expressed in observable modes
the derived charge-ambient ceiling, supervised per battery_pack_contract B8
the VCELL retention floor, which sheds the 5 V rail first on a node the gauge already measures
the BQ25185's own TREG, which folds back the charge current it can reach
the BQ25185's own TSHUT at 150 C, which is the hardware backstop
rev_b: revisit with the measured transfer function in hand
